title: Study of dissipation processes in high-temperature superconductors of ErBa2Cu3O7-δ system near the superconductive transition critical temperature Tc in the range of possible Abrikosov vortex lattice melting
abstract: Abrikosov vortex melting in high-temperature superconductors of ErBa2Cu3O7-δ system is investigated using mechanical contactless method of energy dissipation.
